story.text:
Some people write here in structural or analytical modes.
Others write subjectively, personally, narratively, aesthetically.

All these modes are valid.

I explore ways to map ideas — not to objectify them, and not to require anyone else to adopt the same perspective.
A subjectivist mode of writing is fully legitimate in the federation and needs no justification.

You’re not “signed up” for anything.
Your voice remains yours, exactly as you prefer it.
Zach's sticker in honor of our back and forth. [https://matrix.to/#/#fedwiki:matrix.org/$1764719111544EtcqS:matrix.org matrix]
